backgrounds: A single interior set: a cozy, sunlit living room where two stop-motion figures sit side-by-side on a light beige/taupe sofa. Behind them is a tall window with sheer white curtains letting in warm backlight, and a plain warm-gray/taupe wall. To the left of frame is a side table with a dark vase, a small potted succulent, and a leafy plant. A blurred bowl of fruit sits on a table in the background near the window. No location changes occur within the clip aside from bookend black title/end cards ('LOW BATTERY PEOPLE' / episode title cards) that interrupt the live scene.

dark ceramic vase with dry branch/leaf stems

lighting_notes: Warm, soft backlighting from the window creates a golden hazy glow behind the characters, with gentle key light on their faces; overall lighting is naturalistic, cozy, and slightly hazy/dusty (visible floating particles in the air), giving a sitcom-living-room feel rather than flat/stylized lighting.
color_palette: yellow accent (title text and ticket graphic)
visual_complexity_notes: The living-room set is moderately detailed with tasteful, deliberate set dressing (vase, plant, curtains, fruit bowl) but keeps a shallow depth of field so the background stays soft and out of focus, pushing all visual attention onto the two characters' faces and hands. This is a deliberate minimal-but-warm choice: one consistent, cozy set with subtle texture rather than a busy or shifting environment, letting comedic character expressions and dialogue carry the scene.
